premises.text: Home coffee makers lag third-wave quality, while single-serve pods create waste, high cost, and stale grounds
premises.evidence_span: That wave is not sustainable. It creates a lot of waste

premises.text: A connected centrifugal Spin Coffee Maker brews barista-quality coffee from fresh beans without pods or filters, managing brew variables and spinning out dry grounds
premises.evidence_span: The Spin Coffee Maker uses patented centrifugal force technology to brew your coffee

premises.text: An app marketplace of local roasters auto-replenishes beans when machine sensors detect low stock
premises.evidence_span: The beans get ordered automatically from a marketplace for local coffee roasters

premises.text: Business model takes margin on machines and a cut of every marketplace bean order
premises.evidence_span: we're going to make margins on the machines and the beans
